snippet.title: Wild Terrain - Official Game Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Wild Terrain is an animal adventure game where you play as a wild pig in nature. Your animal friends have mysteriously disappeared, and it’s up to you to find them all! Forage for food and mushrooms, use your strength to smash and move objects, and make friends with other animals. 

Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3301300

Subscribe and/or follow on X and TikTok for further updates.
